elements.description: A stack of toasts in a corner of the page (or of a positioned parent, with `inline`). Show toasts with `toast()`.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Corner (or edge center) the stack sits in

properties.name: inline
properties.description: Positions the stack inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport – for previews and panels

properties.name: stack
properties.description: Only shows toasts sent with { toaster: name } – for a second, separate stack

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Default time on screen in ms

properties.name: actionDuration
properties.description: Default time on screen for toasts with an action. Infinity (the default) keeps them until they're dismissed (WCAG 2.2.1)

properties.name: visibleToasts
properties.description: How many toasts are visible at once; older ones wait behind

properties.name: expand
properties.description: Always show the stack fanned out

properties.name: offset
properties.description: Distance from the edges in px

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Space between toasts when fanned out, in px

properties.name: hotkey
properties.description: Key that moves focus to the newest toast (KeyboardEvent.key or .code) – false (or null) turns it off

properties.name: hairline
properties.description: A 1px line along the bottom of a toast that runs down with its timer

properties.name: closeButton
properties.description: Show a close button on hover and focus (always on touch screens)

properties.name: label
properties.description: Name of the region for screen readers

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

functions.name: resetToasts
functions.description:
Empties the store at once – no exit animation, no onDismiss – and cancels pending exits. Meant for tests
(e.g. in afterEach), since the store lives at module level and would otherwise carry toasts between them

functions.name: toast
functions.description: toast("Saved"), toast.success(…), toast.error(…), toast.info(…), toast.loading(…), toast.promise(…), toast.dismiss(id?)

props.name: id
props.description: Only shows toasts sent with { toaster: id } – for a second, separate stack. Not the element's DOM id

changelog: toaster: toasts with an action don't auto-dismiss (`actionDuration`, default Infinity).
toaster: when several toasters share the hotkey, the newest one with a toast takes it; Ctrl/⌘ + the key no longer triggers it.
